source_verification: Primary DailyMed label text, exact product, section and displayed version checked on 2026-11-07. This establishes the stated label restriction, not patient-specific suitability or validated reference labels.
source_archival_status: Set IDs and displayed versions recorded; local full-label download failed with TLS EOF and is not claimed complete.
negative_policy: A non-trigger is only negative inside the named rule with complete required inputs. It is never an all-category clinically normal prescription. Unknown facts remain indeterminate.
product_mapping_policy: Require an explicit binding to the exact reference formulation with a recorded evidence reference. Matching an ingredient name or a SIM code alone is insufficient.

metformin_ir.product: Metformin hydrochloride immediate-release film-coated tablet, 500 mg

amoxicillin.product: Amoxicillin capsule 500 mg, supplied as the trihydrate

tiotropium_handihaler.product: SPIRIVA HANDIHALER tiotropium 18 microgram inhalation-powder capsule used with HANDIHALER

entresto.product: ENTRESTO film-coated tablet containing sacubitril 24 mg AND valsartan 26 mg

ceftriaxone.product: Ceftriaxone sodium powder for injection, vial equivalent to 1 g ceftriaxone

rules.statement: For this adult immediate-release oral product, the labeled maximum total daily dose is 2550 mg. The rule checks that ceiling only.
required: exact age >=18 or an evidenced documented adult population category, without demographic conflict
fixed known frequency and mg dose

rules.statement: A documented serious hypersensitivity reaction to amoxicillin is a contraindication. This implementation uses confirmed anaphylaxis or Stevens-Johnson syndrome to the same ingredient only.
required: confirmed serious same-ingredient allergy and evidence reference

rules.statement: The powder capsule is inhaled using the HANDIHALER device; swallowing the capsule is explicitly prohibited by the product instructions.
required: explicit swallowed oral route or correct inhaled route with device

rules.statement: Protocol-defined duplication: two distinct active orders reproduce one independently documented intended regimen, with the same product, dose, schedule and overlapping administration intent. A repeated ingredient alone is insufficient.
required: independent plan specifies exactly one active order
distinct IDs and exact clinical signature
rules.label_role: The product label anchors formulation identity only; it does not establish a universal repeated-ingredient prohibition. The duplicate reference comes from the recorded original intended order and mutation audit.

rules.statement: Lisinopril and sacubitril/valsartan must not be given concomitantly. The labels also require a 36-hour switching interval; this first implementation flags only known concurrent use, leaving switching cases for review.
required: complete reconciliation for scoped negative controls
rules.catalogue_scope: sacubitril/valsartan is optional fault-only extension, never a default treatment recommendation

rules.statement: Calcium-containing solutions, including Ringer/Hartmann solutions, must not reconstitute ceftriaxone or further dilute it for IV administration. The restriction is not limited to neonates.
rules.negative_scope: Only checks absence of calcium incompatibility; an exact NS/D5W product with declared 10–40 mg/mL concentration is needed for a scoped non-trigger.
not_covered: sequential adult line use after flushing
